Class ShapeCircleDrawing

Namespace
ShapeEngine.StaticLib.Drawing
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides static methods for drawing circles and circle-related shapes with various options, including filled circles, outlines, sectors, and advanced line drawing with scaling and percentage.

Remarks

This class is intended for use with Raylib and ShapeEngine types. It offers both simple and advanced circle drawing utilities, including performance-optimized methods for small circles.
